sections.heading: Built for how you build.
body: Whatever you’re putting on the web — client sites, a storefront, a startup, a docs site — Aglyn is one platform that adapts to the way you work.

items.title: Agencies
items.body: Run every client site from one console.

items.title: Startups
items.body: Launch fast and iterate without a stack.

items.title: Developers
items.body: Open source, self-host, extend with APIs.

items.title: Enterprise
items.body: Roles, security & scale for big teams.

items.title: Small business
items.body: Everything to get online, one price.

items.title: Online stores
items.body: Products, checkout, POS, and subscriptions — a full store built in.

items.title: Portfolios
items.body: Show your work on a design-first canvas with a real DAM.

items.title: Blogs
items.body: Write, schedule, and publish posts on a fast, global CDN.

items.title: SaaS websites
items.body: Marketing site, docs, pricing, and a store — around your app.

items.title: Documentation
items.body: Publish clean, organized docs and guides as fast pages.

items.title: Membership sites
items.body: Member sign-ups, gated content, and email, all in one place.

sections.heading: Not sure where you fit? Start building.
body: Aglyn is free to start — spin up your first site and see where it takes you.
